recipes.name: Egyptian Beef Kofta
recipes.description: Juicy spiced minced-beef kebabs grilled over charcoal, a cornerstone of Egyptian grilling.

steps.instruction: Knead beef with grated onion, parsley and spices until sticky.
Shape around skewers into long finger-sized kebabs.
Grill over hot coals 10-12 minutes, turning often.
Rest briefly; serve with tahini salad and warm baladi bread.

recipes.name: Hawawshi
recipes.description: Baladi bread stuffed with spiced minced beef and roasted until crisp - Cairo's favorite street sandwich.

steps.instruction: Mix beef with onion, pepper, tomato and spices.
Split bread loaves partially open and stuff evenly with the meat mixture.
Spread butter on the outside; wrap in foil.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes, then unwrap and crisp 5 more minutes.

videos.videoTitle: Authentic Egyptian Hawawshi Recipe | Crispy, Juicy & Better Than Street Food

recipes.name: Egyptian Beef Fattah
recipes.description: Festive layers of crispy bread, garlic-tomato sauce and tender slow-cooked beef over vinegar-kissed rice.

steps.instruction: Simmer beef in salted water with onion until fork-tender, about 75 minutes; reserve stock.
Cook rice in the beef stock until fluffy.
Crush garlic into simmering passata for the red sauce; separately fry garlic in ghee with vinegar for the sharp sauce.
Layer bread, rice and beef; drown in both sauces and serve immediately.

videos.videoTitle: How to make egyptian fattah recipe

recipes.name: Okra Stew with Beef (Bamyia bil Lahma)
recipes.description: Tender baby okra simmered in rich tomato sauce with succulent beef chunks, served over rice.

steps.instruction: Brown beef cubes with onion in ghee; cover with water and simmer 45 minutes until tender.
Fry garlic with coriander until fragrant; stir into tomato passata.
Add okra and sauce to the beef; simmer gently 15 minutes without stirring much.
Season and serve with Egyptian rice.

recipes.name: Egyptian Chicken Shawarma
recipes.description: Vinegar-marinated chicken shaved from the spit, wrapped in baladi bread with tahini and pickles.

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken slices in vinegar, yogurt, garlic and cardamom at least 2 hours.
Stir-fry over high heat until browned edges form, about 12 minutes.
Warm bread; spread with tahini, add chicken and pickles.
Roll tightly and toast seam-side down in a dry pan.

recipes.name: Stuffed Chicken (Firakh Mahshi)
recipes.description: Whole chicken stuffed with herbed rice and roasted until golden - the Egyptian Sunday centerpiece.

steps.instruction: Sauté liver and onion in ghee; stir in rice, herbs, salt and pepper with a splash of water.
Stuff the chicken loosely and seal; rub skin with ghee and pepper.
Roast at 190°C about 60-70 minutes, basting twice, until deeply golden.
Rest 10 minutes; carve and serve with the baked stuffing.

recipes.name: Molokhia with Chicken
recipes.description: Silky jute-leaf soup perfumed with garlic and coriander, poured over rice alongside tender poached chicken.

steps.instruction: Poach chicken in salted water 30 minutes; shred and reserve the stock.
Sizzle garlic and coriander in ghee until golden (taqliya).
Whisk molokhia into hot (not boiling) stock with half the taqliya; heat gently 5 minutes.
Serve broth over rice with shredded chicken and remaining taqliya on top.

recipes.name: Egyptian Koshari
recipes.description: Egypt's beloved national dish: spiced rice and lentils topped with pasta, chickpeas, tangy tomato sauce and crispy fried onions.

steps.instruction: Soak the sliced onions in salt, then deep-fry until golden and crisp. Drain on paper towels.
Simmer lentils in salted water until just tender, about 15 minutes; drain.
Cook rice with a little oil and the lentils' cooking water until fluffy.
Boil macaroni until al dente; drain.
For the sauce, sauté garlic, add passata, vinegar, cumin and a pinch of chili; simmer 10 minutes.
Assemble: layer rice-lentil mix, macaroni, chickpeas, spoon over sauce and crown with crispy onions.

recipes.name: Ful Medames
recipes.description: Slow-simmered fava beans mashed with olive oil, lemon, cumin and garlic - Egypt's ancient breakfast staple.

steps.instruction: Simmer soaked fava beans 45-60 minutes until very soft.
Mash coarsely with some of their cooking liquid.
Stir in olive oil, lemon, garlic, cumin and salt.
Top with tomato, olive oil drizzle and eat with warm bread.

recipes.name: Ta'ameya (Egyptian Falafel)
recipes.description: Crisp fritters of ground fava beans and herbs - Egypt's greener, fluffier answer to falafel.

steps.instruction: Blend drained beans with herbs, onion, garlic and spices to a coarse paste.
Rest the mix 30 minutes; shape into flattened discs.
Deep-fry at 175°C until deep golden, about 4 minutes; drain well.

steps.instruction: Mix rice with herbs, tomato, oil, salt and pepper.

Pack rolls snugly in a pot lined with spare leaves.
Pour stock with lemon over; weigh down with a plate; simmer covered 50 minutes.

recipes.description: Warm Egyptian bread pudding baked with pistachios, raisins and cream - the country's favorite dessert.

steps.instruction: Bake pastry sheets until golden, then break into pieces into a buttered baking dish.

Heat milk with sugar and vanilla until dissolved; pour evenly over the pastry.
Top with cream and remaining pistachios; bake at 190°C for 25 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Basbousa
recipes.description: Semolina cake soaked in fragrant sugar syrup, studded with almonds - Egypt's easiest showstopper dessert.

steps.instruction: Mix semolina, sugar, yogurt, ghee and baking powder; rest 20 minutes.
Press into a greased tray; score diamonds and top each with an almond.
Bake at 180°C for 30-35 minutes until golden.
Pour cool syrup over the hot cake; rest before cutting along the scores.
